query:
SELECT (
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM deployments
                    WHERE credential_id = $1
                      AND status <> 'deleted'
                )
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM data_planes dp
                    JOIN cluster_inventory ci ON ci.data_plane_id = dp.id
                    WHERE dp.credential_id = $1
                      AND ci.released_at IS NULL
                )
            ) AS "in_use!"
